summary: Single File PHP Gallery is a lightweight web application contained entirely within a single PHP script to display images stored on a server. It provides a straightforward way to present photo collections without requiring complex database setups or multi-file directory structures.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users who need to quickly host a basic photo directory on a standard web hosting environment with minimal administrative overhead.
watchOut: The software uses a proprietary licence, and with no recent commits or releases, you may encounter unresolved bugs or security vulnerabilities without official updates.
deployNotes: You will typically need a web server with PHP support enabled and persistent storage configured in the same directory for your image files.
